Claude.name: Claude Fable 5.2
Claude.why: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 on all platforms on Nov 9, 2026, and calls it its strongest lead agent; its model docs recommend Fable 5.2 over Opus 5.5 for demanding reasoning and long-horizon work, and Mythos 5.2 is not in this account's list.

ChatGPT.name: GPT-6 Astra
ChatGPT.why: OpenAI's current model docs call GPT-6 Astra its flagship model for complex reasoning and coding, and present the newer GPT-6.1 Sol as the cheaper option that comes close to Astra but does not match it.

Gemini.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
Gemini.why: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available on Nov 10, 2026, and calls it its strongest frontier model for the hardest long-horizon work, ranking it above Argon, its default frontier model.

Grok.name: Grok 4.7
Grok.why: xAI's release notes describe Grok 4.7 (Sept 2026) as its frontier model for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, and nothing newer has been released.
